We’re Hiring | Electrical Engineer

Petrocon is looking for an experienced Electrical Engineer with strong detailed engineering capabilities and hands-on experience in electrical design, calculations, layouts, specifications, and project deliverables.

Role: Electrical Engineer
Location: Mangalore
Experience: 3-10 Years
Qualification: B.Tech / M.Tech in Electrical or Electrical & Electronics Engineering

Key Responsibilities:

→ Manage multiple projects and independently develop engineering solutions aligned with client requirements
→ Prepare design basis, specifications, datasheets, electrical load lists, and cable schedules
→ Develop single-line diagrams and protection schemes up to 132 kV
→ Perform engineering calculations including cable, transformer, DG, breaker, busbar, battery, UPS, earthing, lighting and lightning protection sizing
→ Prepare switchyard, equipment, earthing, cable routing, lighting, power, hazardous-area and heat-tracing layouts
→ Prepare Material Requisitions, Technical Bid Evaluations, BOQs and MTOs
→ Review vendor drawings and documentation for compliance with project requirements
→ Prepare termination schedules, block diagrams, deliverable lists and as-built documentation
→ Coordinate across disciplines and support resolution of technical discrepancies

Required Technical Skills:

✓ Design Basis & Specification Preparation
✓ Electrical Load List & Cable Schedule Preparation
✓ SLDs and Protection Schemes
✓ Electrical Sizing & Engineering Calculations
✓ Electrical Layout Development
✓ BOQ / MTO Preparation
✓ AutoCAD
✓ DIALux
✓ Microsoft Office

Knowledge of ETAP and DIALux is mandatory for candidates with more than 3 years of experience, including exposure to Load Flow, Short Circuit, Relay Coordination and Arc Flash Studies.

Candidates should also be familiar with applicable engineering standards including OISD, NEC, IEEE, IEC, IS, NFPA, NEMA, KOC and ADNOC requirements.

If your experience matches the role, we’d like to hear from you.

Share your CV with vasanth@petroconengineers.net

• Audit sales calls, product demos, recordings, and transcripts
